honesty: Corroboration compares two aggregations of the SAME unvalidated pollen proxy. Agreement raises confidence in the spatial ALLOCATION; it does NOT validate the proxy. Monoculture is real inventory; co_benefit is a ranking lens, not a claim. Thermal is a guardrail, not a priority.
